change_reason: V3 preserves V2's fair sequential comparator and replaces the historical six-scenario reference with 24 freshly generated EPANET/WNTR TRACE scenarios using pressure-dependent demand and explicit uncertainty in source, demand, tank state, and pipe closure.
information_contract: All policies receive the same calibrated risk interval, 12 candidates, 24-scenario reach ensemble, consequence weights, cutoff and budget. Adaptive SDAIF and adaptive Bayesian receive a test result only after selecting that test.
hidden_truth_contract: The hidden hydraulic scenario is sampled after all policy inputs are frozen and is never passed to a selector.
pass_rule: At budget 3, adaptive SDAIF passes if its paired mean Coverage@3 is not more than 0.02 below the strongest declared fair baseline; superiority additionally requires the paired 95% bootstrap interval to be above zero.
claim_boundary: E. coli-referenced surface-water risk evidence joined to a simulated public benchmark drinking-water network. Hydraulic parameters are benchmark assumptions, including PDA and stress scenarios; no Delhi-NCR, field, biological-sensor, or municipal validation.
